_readme: Catalogue configuration. Edit this file to change which species appear where. Every slug must exist in the final catalogue (npm run check:data and npm test enforce this).

archived.reason: The original dataset held 10 mammals but the catalogue allows 8 per group. Archived, not deleted: it is the third big cat alongside the Amur and snow leopards and is the closest mammal to a duplicate of an existing story. The full record is still in data/species-dataset.json and data/species-enrichment.json.
Same reason: the second great ape alongside the mountain gorilla. Archived, not deleted; restore by removing it from this list and archiving a different mammal.
